interface.longDescription: Release v0.22.1: opt-in Korean structured-answer and evidence evaluation, generated proposal/operation lifecycle regressions, and bounded synthetic tool-call episodes. Scripted controls are separate from actual local-model results; the observed model failed both Korean tasks. Hypothesis is test-only. Existing memory, diagnostics, provenance, budgets and Jarvis API-auth boundary remain. No default network/model call or automatic vault migration.
